item.title: Wright State knocks off IU Indianapolis
item.description: Wright State defeated IU Indianapolis 85-73 on Thursday. Kyler D'Augustino finished with 20 points and two steals for the Jaguars.

item.title: Washington Wizards outlast Indiana Pacers
item.description: The Washington Wizards outlasted the Indiana Pacers 112-105 on Thursday night, with Bub Carrington and Anthony Gill each scoring 13 points to spark a decisive fourth-quarter run.

item.title: Athlete of the week: Heritage Christian’s Riley Johnson
item.description: Riley Johnson helped lead Heritage Christian to a regional championship in girls basketball with her team-high 17 points per game and 3.5 steals per game, as they look to win their first state championship since 2016.

item.title: The Zone Extra | February 19, 2026
item.description: Highlights from four girls basketball regional championships, boys basketball games, Trayce Jackson-Davis's return to his high school, and more can be found in this week's The Zone Extra.

item.title: Storefront tributes honor fallen officer, support Beech Grove police
item.description: Businesses in downtown Beech Grove have placed signs in their windows to honor officer Brian Elliott and show their support for the Beech Grove Police Department during a difficult week.

item.title: Visitation, funeral details released for Beech Grove Ofc. Brian Elliott
item.description: BEECH GROVE, Ind. (WISH) — Funeral and visitation arrangements have been made to honor the life of fallen Beech Grove Ofc. Brian Elliott. Elliott died Monday after being fatally shot during a disturbance call at a Beech Grove apartment complex. item.title: Indianapolis south side shooting leaves man dead
item.description: A man died after being shot in a residential area on the south side of Indianapolis, police said.

item.title: Senate could vote next week to send immigrant employment bill to governor
item.description: The Indiana State Senate is set to vote on a bill that would prohibit employers from hiring someone who lacks legal status, and require all governmental bodies to comply with ICE requests.

item.title: Chicago Bears one step closer to Indiana move as stadium bill passes committee
item.description: The Chicago Bears have decided to relocate to Hammond, Indiana, with the state legislature creating the Northwest Indiana Stadium Authority to finance a 35-year lease deal for a new NFL stadium.

item.title: Bloomington tornado damages airport, homes, businesses, animal shelter
item.description: A tornado touched down on Thursday night in Bloomington, Indiana, causing damage to homes, a bank, and the county airport, and leaving over 1,800 customers without power. Send your tornado damage photos to photos@wishtv.com.
